description: Add optional comment field to aisles and add few-shot example to Bedrock sort prompt to improve sorting quality
steps: Update libs/shared/src/index.ts: add Aisle interface with name (string) and comment (optional string), change Supermarket.aisles to Aisle[]
Update apps/api/src/handler.ts: update createSupermarket and updateSupermarket validation to accept Aisle objects, update sortIngredients to pass comments in prompt and add few-shot example
Update apps/web/src/app/supermarkets/supermarket-form.component.ts: change aisles to Aisle[], add comment input field next to each aisle
Update apps/web/src/app/supermarkets/supermarket.service.ts: update sortIngredients to pass Aisle[] instead of string[]
Update apps/web/src/app/supermarkets/supermarket-view.component.ts: update to pass full Aisle objects to sortIngredients
Update apps/web/src/app/supermarkets/supermarket-list.component.ts: no changes needed since it just accesses aisles.length
Add i18n keys for comment placeholder in en.json and de.json
acceptance_criteria: Aisle interface exported from shared library with name and optional comment fields

API validation accepts objects with name (required string) and comment (optional string)

Bedrock sort prompt includes a few-shot example showing expected behavior
Frontend form shows comment input next to each aisle name
sortIngredients service passes full Aisle[] to the API
npx nx run-many -t build lint passes cleanly
